$comment:
W5-2 search engine query list (id prefix 'search-' implied by category). Hand-curated. Each entry is one intent, run against SearXNG (10 instances, round-robin), HN Algolia, and GitHub Trending. Cron: every 60 minutes (apps/worker/src/schedules.ts -> search.fetch). Schema changes need a worker restart.

W5-3 prompt column queries (id prefix 'prompt-'): same SearXNG instances, but consumed by a SEPARATE worker job (apps/worker/src/jobs/prompt-fetch.ts - NOT search-fetch.ts; prompt queries write directly to prompt_items, not articles, so no searchMeta badge and no editorial re-score). HN Algolia / GitHub Trending are NOT run for prompts - they don't surface prompt content well. Cron: every 60 minutes, separate schedule slot. Worker job is NOT in this commit - see docs/features/prompts-collection.md WBS for V1 sequencing.

2026-10-05 FIX-F: paused rss-xai and rss-theresanaiforthat (VPS fetch 403'd; defer per user 'only fix what we can, defer VPS external network issues'). Two new search queries (search-grok-xai-release, search-new-ai-tool-launch) cover the topic surface via SearXNG + HN Algolia + GitHub Trending redundancy. Net: 12 to 14 search queries. Prompt queries untouched.

2026-10-05 FIX-J: added 4 lang:zh search queries (search-china-llm-release, search-deepseek-qwen-glm, search-china-ai-news, search-china-robotics-ai) per user 'continue expanding sources, especially Chinese domestic AI info'. Most Chinese AI media sites have no public RSS (qbitai.com is the only one probed with a working feed; jiqizhixin/36kr returned non-RSS / 500). Chinese AI lab blogs (deepseek-ai.com, qwen.ai, zhipuai.cn) have no RSS either; releases land on HuggingFace/GitHub. So the rest goes through SearXNG Chinese-engine round-robin. HN Algolia / GitHub Trending are English-only and will return 0 zh results; net fan-out adds ~4 SearXNG fetches/cycle plus the rss-qbitai RSS row (T2 media, interval 120 min). Net: 14 to 18 search queries.
